column4: void* MotionLodParamsBuild(u32* p, f32 dt, f32 dtRaw, void* cam)
column5: Fills the 0xE0-byte per-frame character update block: [0..1] dt, [4..7] camera pos, +0x3C GetLodLevelCount (MOTION_QUALITY), +0x50, distances 1000/3000/1500, +0x94..+0xAC MODEL_QUAL-scaled distances. column4: int PagePoolCountUsed(void* cache, u64 frame, u32* fullSets)
column5: 275 B; counts ways whose keep-until stamp (+8) >= frame over every set of 1 or 3 pool types, plus the number of fully used sets. Result -> pool+B2Ch (previous value in +B30h = device+6CD0h), read only by PagePoolOccupancyCheck's >85 % test. 2-3 % of the PC main thread, 0.2-0.6 % of Ally main

783 B; occupancy % = (used(device+6CD0h) - reserved(max(+756C,+7570) + +7584 + +757C + +7578)) x 100 / pool size; pushes (pct > 85) into OccupancyWindowPush (t+3C8h); every 0.3 x window steps a streaming bias t+3C0h by 0.1 (cap 10 - t+3BCh) while the window says over; state t+B58h = 2 after a camera move > 100 units or > 30 degrees

column4: bool ResourceIsReady(Resource* r, void* ctx, Mgr* m, Listener* l)
column5: 2027 B, 446 callers. State r+18h: bits 20-27 = 8 stage-done bits, bit 19 = loaded, bit 29 = busy (CAS; losing the race returns not-ready), bit 28 = validate. Runs the type's stage step (vfunc +D0h of r+20h) for the first undone stage, recurses into r+30h, then ALWAYS calls ResourceDependenciesReady, also for a fully ready resource: every call re-walks the whole dependency tree (no cached subtree-ready bit). Atomic loads are lock cmpxchg. Three Sleep(0) spins (1A6255/1A6305/1A63CD) on handle-slot bit 31
